facts.fact: IANS reports that on 29 September 2026 India's High Commissioner met UNDP and UNCDF to review the e-KYC and Digital Identity Project in Malawi, funded through the India-UN Development Partnership Fund and implemented with the Reserve Bank of Malawi; the report states no verification service in use.
